dual-pistol-dash-at-rest.scope: Actual L36 stock client with loaded Handguns and held dual handguns 2496. Ally and 19.5 m selection refused as reasons 24/34 with no spend or timer. The Enrage icon and caster notices were visible. No PvP round occurred. Recipient helper confirmed two matching eight-second 500/93 and 93/0 lifecycles, with exact restriction masks 1/21/2021 and 2020/2000/0 hex.
